title: Excel Formulas
description: Test your knowledge of common Excel functions

questions.question: Which formula sums values in cells A1 to A10?
questions.explanation: SUM() adds all values in a range.

questions.question: What does VLOOKUP do?
questions.explanation: VLOOKUP searches for a value in the first column of a range.

questions.question: Which formula calculates the average of cells B1 to B5?
questions.explanation: AVERAGE() calculates the arithmetic mean of the specified cells.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the IF function?
options: Counts the number of cells in a range
Rounds a number to the nearest integer
Adds up cells that meet a condition
Performs a logical test and returns one value if true, another if false
questions.explanation: The IF function performs a logical test and returns different values based on the result.

questions.question: Which formula concatenates the text in cells A1 and B1?
questions.explanation: CONCATENATE() combines the text from multiple cells into one cell.

questions.question: What does the COUNTIF function do?
options: Adds the values of cells that meet a condition
Counts the number of cells that meet a condition
Rounds numbers to a specified number of digits
Finds the maximum value in a range
questions.explanation: COUNTIF() counts the number of cells within a range that meet the given condition.

questions.question: Which formula returns the current date and time?
questions.explanation: NOW() returns the current date and time, while TODAY() returns only the date.

questions.question: What is the result of =LEFT('Excel', 2)?
questions.explanation: LEFT() extracts the specified number of characters from the start of a text string.

questions.question: Which formula rounds a number to the nearest integer?
questions.explanation: ROUND(number, 0) rounds a number to the nearest integer.

questions.question: What does the PMT function calculate?
options: The present value of an investment
The payment for a loan based on constant payments and interest rate
The future value of an investment
questions.explanation: PMT() calculates the periodic payment for a loan with fixed payments and interest rate.
